err_check_failed: xbps check failed, see the system log for details
err_check_timeout: Timed out while checking for updates
err_flatpak_failed: Flatpak check failed, see the system log for details
err_no_terminal: No terminal emulator found, set one in the plugin settings
err_no_xbps: xbps-install not found, check your PATH
err_no_xdg_open: xdg-open not found, cannot open the package page

launcher.check_subtitle: Check xbps and Flatpak for updates
launcher.update_subtitle: Open a terminal and run the update

reboot_recommended: Reboot recommended, the running kernel is no longer installed

assume_yes.description: Pass -y so package managers do not ask for confirmation. Off means you confirm each one in the terminal window.
assume_yes.label: Answer yes automatically

auto_check_hours.description: Check for updates automatically every N hours. 0 (default) never checks on its own.
auto_check_hours.label: Auto-check interval (hours)

check_cmd.description: Full override for the update-check command. Empty (default) uses 'xbps-install -Mun', a rootless in-memory repo sync that needs no prior 'sudo xbps-install -S'. A custom command must print one 'pkgver update ...' line per pending package.
check_cmd.label: Custom check command

check_reboot_needed.description: Detect whether the currently running kernel's files are still on disk. When they are gone, a newer kernel was installed and a reboot is what switches you to it.
check_reboot_needed.label: Check if a reboot is needed

elevation.description: How to gain root for the update. Auto (default) uses sudo when present, else doas, else runs without elevation.
elevation.label: Elevation

flatpak_enabled.description: Also check (and, on Update, run) 'flatpak update'. Ignored automatically when flatpak is not installed.
flatpak_enabled.label: Include Flatpak

glyph.description: The glyph shown for the widget on the bar.
glyph.label: Bar glyph

hide_on_empty.description: Hide the widget entirely when there are no pending updates and no reboot recommendation. Off (default) always shows the glyph.
hide_on_empty.label: Hide when there is nothing to show

ignore_packages.description: Package names to leave out of the count. On Update, pending xbps and Flatpak packages that are ignored are left at their current version.
ignore_packages.label: Ignore packages

notify_on_updates.description: Send a desktop notification when a check finds packages to upgrade.
notify_on_updates.label: Notify when updates are found

show_count.description: Show the number of pending updates next to the bar glyph.
show_count.label: Show the update count

terminal.description: Terminal command used for the update run, e.g. kitty or ghostty. Empty (default) uses Noctalia's terminal detection ($TERMINAL, then the common emulators).
terminal.label: Terminal

update_cmd.description: Full override for the command run in the terminal on Update. Empty (default) builds it from the ignore list, Flatpak and 'Answer yes' settings above.
update_cmd.label: Custom update command

status_missing: xbps-install not found, check your PATH
tip_update: Run the update in a terminal window
title: Void Updater
